verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is an agentic-payments platform, so per-agent spend caps and revocation are a fair question. The evidence only documents tokenization, session-scoped UCP tokens, and optional session cancellation for inventory release. None of these are user-configurable spend caps, usage limits, or instant revocation of an agent's payment authority. The marketing line about staying "fully in control" is too vague to count as support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set per-agent spend caps and usage limits and revoke an agent's payment authority instantly
